title: Fish Bait
meta_description: Nestled inside Grayton Beach State Park, you’ll find the laid-back, eclectic town of Grayton Beach. This well-loved paradise sports tree-lined and moss-draped side streets, you’ll understand why this tiny enclave is considered the heart and soul of 30A.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Fish Bait
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionNestled inside Grayton Beach State Park, you’ll find the laid-back, eclectic town of Grayton Beach. This well-loved paradise sports tree-lined and moss-draped side streets, you’ll understand why this tiny enclave is considered the heart and soul of 30A. Make sure you leave plenty of time to luxuriate in the wide sandy shores of Grayton Beach State Park, one of Dr. Beach’s top 3 beaches in the US!Set in an ideal location, you’re just a seven minute walk from both the beach and Grayton’s famous Red Bar Restaurant.Enter this gracious Grayton Beach home and find yourself awash in light and air. With two levels of covered porches, you’ll feel like a proper southerner as you sip your afternoon sweet tea and look over the neighborhood. Enjoy the privacy of your fenced back yard complete with a 24x8 built-in pool, perfect for warm summer days.Indoors, you’ll find an expansive first-floor great room that allows for plenty of family fun and interaction. The living room offers plenty of comfy seating, an LCD TV, and a cooling ceiling fan. The group gourmet will love the chef’s kitchen, complete with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a center island.The first floor also boasts a master suite with a king bed and a master bath with dual vanities and an oversized walk-in shower.Upstairs is a den with a wrap-around sofa, perfect for the kids to hang out. Additionally, there are three bedrooms, including another king master. The kids’ room was carefully put together with fun in mind, offering sleeping for 4 (with one mini-twin), a coloring table, and bean bag chairs. The fourth bedroom has accommodations for 4, with two double beds, and shares the hall bath with the kids’ room.Home Highlights- 7 Minutes or a very quick bike ride to the beach- 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes- Private Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)- Clean Bedding ProgramFIRST FLOOR- Living Room with Sofa, 3 Side Chairs, Coffee Table, 2 End Tables with Lamps, HDTV- Dining Room with Seating for 6- Kitchen with Quartz Counters, Stainless Steel Appliances, Center Island with Pendant Lights- MASTER BEDROOM with King Bed, Dual Nightstands and Lamps, Chair, Ceiling Fan- MASTER BATH with Dual Vanities, Walk-In Shower- Half Bath- Laundry CenterSECOND FLOOR- Den with Wrap-Around Sofa and HDTV- MASTER BEDROOM with King Bed, 2 Nightstands, 2 Lamps, Side Chair- MASTER BATH with Dual Vanities, Walk-In Shower- BEDROOM with Two Double Beds, Ceiling Fan- BEDROOM with Single Bed, Triple Bunk with Mini-Twin in Middle, Coloring Table, 2 Bean Bag Chairs- Full Hall Bath*This property rents on a Saturday-to-Saturday basis during Spring Break & Summer*
